# Standard delivery

Mainland delivery within zones A and B costs £49 for orders below £1,000 and is included for orders of £1,000 or more. Zone C delivery costs £89 regardless of order value. Charges cover one delivery attempt to an accessible ground-floor entrance.

# Limitations

Offshore islands and addresses outside the published zones require a manager quotation. Narrow roads, parking restrictions, stairs, or restricted access may require an additional service. The assistant cannot schedule a date or promise access suitability.
